sentences.en: The treaty has been concluded after many twists and turns.
sentences.zh: 经过许多曲折后，条约终于达成了。

sentences.en: We have to conclude that the policy is a failure.
sentences.zh: 我们得出结论，这项政策失败了。

sentences.en: I was too hasty in concluding that he was lying.
sentences.zh: 我太草率地断定他在撒谎。

senses.zh: 结束，终止,推断,议定vt.得出结论,缔结,推断出,决定vi.终了,作出决定或达成协议
